resolved_findings.finding: Failed bootstrap may leave missing RAM accounts or managed marker. Actual final Inspection and ready authentication require both. Existing producers require original bootstrap owner; shutdown observation supplies no such authority.
resolved_findings.resolution: Dedicated shutdown-EX verifier checks actual durable cohort without RAM account/marker dependence; unchanged ordinary boot verification remains mandatory.

resolved_findings.finding: Root-only retained parent removes pathname access but cannot revoke previously open disk/directory descriptors, cwd or mapped pages. VM census alone proves no KVM consumer, not no guest-UID process retaining mutable disk custody. Existing disk consumer helper scans only process main fd tables.
resolved_findings.resolution: Bounded all-task FD/mapping/cwd/root/executable and target UID process census, plus old disk custody through cleanup, prevents relying on private-parent rename to revoke old access.

resolved_findings.finding: Final Inspection opens canonical payload and takes disk EX. Constructing it while registry EX is held reverses disk-before-registry order; independently held staging disk EX self-conflicts. Existing RootDirectory and Inspection pin named edges and cannot transparently survive directory rename.
resolved_findings.resolution: Registry sections are short and released before new disk acquisition; dedicated rename-aware handles pin and revalidate named identities, moved-directory and parent durability.

resolved_findings.finding: Pre-intent construction failures create STATE/p5 artifacts but resume currently assumes immutable intent. Unqualified census rejection can make these artifacts permanently block boot. Census before accounts still allows STATE.prepare to publish markers first.
resolved_findings.resolution: Private pre-intent stages are harmless retained artifacts outside discovery; no canonical writes until durable intent. Census precedes state/account/marker preparation.

resolved_findings.finding: Durable completion is published before source/context/descriptor cleanup, yet cleanup failure must not count as completed restore. Reboot loses in-memory failure and census can see only completion. No final record can certify its own successful close.
resolved_findings.resolution: Durable data commit is distinct from command success. Cleanup uncertainty preserves acknowledged data commit; boot census checks data commit and fresh boot authentication separately.

resolved_findings.finding: Ordered reachable states need explicit cartesian constraints across payload, lifecycle, registry and receipt steps. Old/new registry equality alone misses later disk/head mutations without registry change. Completed historical transactions cannot be revalidated against current bytes as if still current after a legitimate guest run.
resolved_findings.resolution: Explicit cross-component phases, absence observations, exact inode/content resume and historical-only completed observation protect against stale replay and legitimate later guest mutation.

requirements: Where incomplete resume still sees original damaged payload, bind observed original bytes in the intent/observation and compare them on resume; corruption recovery must not require those bytes to match the registry manifest. Hash observation is distinct from requiring old integrity.
Originally absent objects carry explicit absence and no nonexistent old-disk lock requirement.
Restore-only verifier must inspect actual destination content and authority; pure parsed source records are insufficient.
Unrelated guests remain exact/current completed cohorts. Missing accounts/markers is the only observation relaxed; account conflicts or foreign owners do not grant launch authority.
Reserved private stages must be explicitly safe and ignored by every relevant boot identity discovery path, with bounded census refusing unsafe or unbounded records.

Full required regressions, privileged filesystem interruption tests, independent implementation review and physical A733 restore/reboot/KVM validation remain mandatory. Replacement-drive migration remains a separate blocked scope.
limitations: No destination publisher is available yet. Custody implementation is separate work, excluded from the current controls validation freeze.
Host fixtures, real filesystem interruption/retry checks, independent implementation review, fresh A733 boot and actual nonroot KVM restoration are required before acceptance.
